column1: # What Morpheus (perseids-tools/morpheus, commit ab6898ffed335fc6169fa02c9940657a9b5a78e0, MPL-2.0) is taken to print for the seven forms of Gen 1 and Ps 22 that
# layers 1 and 2 leave with no candidate (tests/unit/lxx-morpheus.test.ts): form, then the <NL> segments of its Perseus-format output in beta code, one after another.
# NOT captured from the image (no Docker on the Builder's host): written in the shape of the examples in the pinned repository's test/fixture.json, with ⇥
# standing for the tab Morpheus prints inside a segment. ζωσῶν has no segment (Morpheus does not know it); αὐταί has a class the mapping does not cover;
# καταδιώξεται has a second, epic-only reading that is left unmapped.

column2: <NL>V katadiw/kw  fut ind mid 3rd sg⇥⇥⇥w_stem,fut</NL><NL>V katadiw/kw  fut ind pass 3rd sg⇥epic⇥⇥w_stem,fut</NL>
